{{Top}}
[[File:Felucian_Shaman_TFUCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Felucian shaman]]
A '''shaman''', also known as a '''medicine man''',<ref name="The Ewoks Join the Fight">[[The Ewoks Join the Fight (storybook)|''The Ewoks Join the Fight'' storybook]]</ref> was a member of a primitive society, usually an elder, who was thought to have mystical powers or be able to communicate with spirits or [[Deity/Legends|deities]]. Shamans had various roles depending on the species and the level of sapience. They existed in the societies of the [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]], [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Felucians]], [[Gutretee (species)|Gutretees]], [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]], [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanians]], [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand people]], [[Tintinna/Legends|Tintinna]], [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>, [[Atoan]]s<ref name="DVLC2">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2]]</ref> and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].<ref name="RageoftheWookiees">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> There was also a Shaman of the [[Ancient Order of the Whills|Whills]], although the exact nature of this shaman is unknown.

Often, the shaman was actually a [[Force Adept]]. They used their connection with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to heal or provide insight to the future. They were considered wise and often served as mediators in conflicts. Usually pacifistic, some shamans were well trained in the martial arts and engaged in battles with the warriors from their tribe.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref>

Apart from her ability to communicate with the [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|other realm]], the [[Shaman of the Nightsisters|Nightsister shaman]] was also the keeper of the artifacts. Apparently, all Nightsister talismans and other Force-imbued items belonged to the community and were placed under the authority of the shaman. Indeed, the [[Witch/Legends|witches]] had to borrow the artifacts and return them afterwards. When [[Charal]] turned her back on her sisters and left [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], she secretly stole the [[Talisman of the Raven]]. Many years later, in her manifesto ''[[Wild Power]]'', clan shaman [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] complained about "one of the sisters" never returning the talisman.<ref name="Book of Sith" />
